AbsentFrom.description: Which run of a comparison lacks a node a pair drawn by hand names.

oneOf.description: The baseline lacks the pair's `node`.
The run lacks the pair's `other`.
Each lacks its node.

BenchmarkEntry.description: One benchmark the registry knows: named by the manifest, or imported.

format.description:
The format that reads it: `beir`, `beir-qa` or `squad`; `unknown` for
an import whose record cannot be read.

ground_truth.description:
The ground truth it carries, read off the loaded dataset; `null` when
nothing on disk loaded.

licence.description:
The dataset's licence, for a benchmark the manifest names, whatever
its state: a downloaded dataset keeps the notice it was obtained
under. `null` for an import, whose licence is its owner's.

licence_url.description: Where that licence is stated; `null` with it.

name.description:
Its selector, `<format>/<dir>` — `beir/scifact` — as `ragondin bench
--benchmark` takes it; for an import whose record cannot be read, its
directory's name alone.

state.description: Where it stands against the digest expected of it.

benchmarks.description: The manifest's entries in manifest order, then the imports by name.

BenchmarkState.description:
Where a benchmark stands. Every verdict is a statement about digests: the
dataset on disk is loaded and its `dataset_version` compared with the one
expected — the manifest's, or the one recorded at import.

oneOf.description: On disk, and its digest is the manifest's.
Named by the manifest, not on disk.
On disk, and its digest is another.
On disk, and it does not load.
Imported, and its digest is the one recorded at import.

Capabilities.description:
What this build can run: the local implementations of each family, and
whether it can call a `Remote` one.

families.description: One entry per family, as the launcher lists them.

remote.description: Whether this build carries the `remote` feature.

CompareRequest.description:
`POST /compare`: the runs to compare, the baseline among them, and
optionally a manual pairing to keep before comparing.

baseline.description: The run the others are compared against.

pairing.description:
A manual pairing between the baseline's workspace pipeline and
another compared run's: applied to this comparison, then kept —
replacing any — once the answer is built, so a refused request keeps
nothing. With no pairs, it is removed and the two pipelines pair
automatically again. Absent changes nothing.

run_ids.description:
The runs, by id: two to five, each once, the baseline among them. The
answer puts the baseline first and the others in this order.

pipeline.description:
The workspace pipeline whose manual pairings apply to it (decided in #402): the
name its launch record gives when it has one, whether or not that
pipeline's content has changed since; otherwise the one pipeline
document whose canonical hash is the run's. `null` when it has no
record naming one and no document, or several, holds its hash; such a
run is paired automatically only. The lookup's answer, not a claim
about which version the run is: a run of earlier content gets the
pairs whose nodes it still has, and the rest are in
[`Comparison::unplaced_pairs`].

pipeline_hash.description: The content hash of the canonical logical pipeline it ran.

Comparison.description:
`POST /compare`: runs of one benchmark compared against a baseline.

Every list with one entry per run — a metric's values, a stage's cells —
is in the order of [`runs`](Self::runs): the baseline first, then the
other runs in the order the request gave them.

cache_errors.description:
Why derived figures could not be cached under the workspace's
`cache/`, one entry per failure; empty otherwise. The response is
complete either way.

configuration.description: The configuration parameters not identical across the runs.

ground_truth.description:
Whether the benchmark on disk is the one the runs were evaluated on,
which the per-query deltas and the per-stage metrics are read
against. Without `verified`, `query_deltas` is empty and no stage
cell carries a metric; the table, the matrix, the stages and the
latency do not depend on it.

latency.description: Each run's latency, node by node.

metrics.description: One row per metric any run recorded, in name order.

pairings.description:
The manual pairings in use: one per run whose pipeline the workspace
holds a pairing for with the baseline's, oriented from the baseline's
pipeline.

query_deltas.description:
Each run other than the baseline: its per-query deltas against the
baseline, for every ranking metric both recorded.

runs.description: The runs compared, the baseline first.

stages.description:
The stages the runs are aligned by, in pipeline order: those at least
one run has.

unplaced_pairs.description:
Every pair of [`pairings`](Self::pairings) a run could not place,
with the run and the side lacking its node, in the runs' order; empty
when every pair was placed.

Confidence.description: How sure an automatic pairing is.

oneOf.description: Every graph was unambiguous at this stage, or the pairing is by hand.
A guess: the UI offers the manual pairing.

ConfigurationMatrix.description:
The configuration parameters not identical across the runs, or why that
could not be said.

oneOf.description: Every stored configuration lowered.

parameters.description:
Every parameter — family and `impl:` name included — whose value
is not the same in every run, sorted by node and key.

same_logical_form.description:
Whether every canonical logical form hashes equal: runs that
differ only in their wiring have no row, and are still not one
configuration.

oneOf.description: A run's stored configuration does not lower under this build.

reason.description: What the parser or the validation pass said.

ConsumedPorts.description: What a node family's input edges carry.

oneOf.description: Exactly these kinds, in this order: port `i` carries `kinds[i]`.

kinds.description: One kind per port, in port order.

oneOf.description: Any number of ports, every one carrying `kind`.

ContentSinceChanged.description:
A run launched as the matrix's pipeline whose content has since changed:
stated as a fact, never guessed to be an earlier version (ADR-C39 § 7).

difference.description:
Its parameter difference against the pipeline's current document, by
`POST /compare`'s configuration matrix, the current document's column
first.

launched.description: How its record says it was launched.

DatasetCheck.description:
Whether the dataset on disk is the one a run was evaluated on: the
benchmark pinned to the run's `dataset_version`, digesting to it — and,
for passage text, its derived chunk set digesting to the run's
`index_version`.

benchmark.description:
The benchmark the run's `dataset_version` is pinned to, by its
selector; `null` when the registry pins no benchmark to it.

detail.description: The verdict in words: what was compared, and what differed.

found.description:
The digests of what is on disk, as far as they were computed; `null`
when nothing on disk loaded.

oneOf.description:
On disk, and every digest compared is the run's: the dataset's for
the ground truth, the dataset's and the chunk set's for passage text.
Not on disk, or pinned by no benchmark the registry knows.
On disk, and its digest is not the run's `dataset_version`.
On disk, and it does not load: `detail` carries the adapter's error.

Passage text only: the dataset is the run's, but the chunk set this
build derives from it does not digest to the run's `index_version` —
the derivation moved. The scores are unaffected.

DatasetVersions.description: The two dataset digests of a run's identity.

DeltaBin.description: One bin of the per-query histogram.

lower.description: Its lower bound; `null` for the lowest.

upper.description: Its upper bound; `null` for the highest.

DeltaBinName.description:
The seven bins of a delta `d`: by its sign, and its magnitude against
0.1 and 0.3. A bound belongs to the bin nearer zero.

oneOf.description: `d = 0`: the same score.

EdgeKind.description: The kind of value travelling along an edge.

oneOf.description: The question.
A list of retrieved chunks.
An assembled context.
A generator's answer.
A value an extension node produces, unknown to the core.

EdgeLocation.description: An edge, as a location names it.

from.description: The producing node or declared input.

port.description: The position of the edge among `to`'s inputs, from 0.

FamilyCapabilities.description:
One family: its ports, the local implementations this build carries in
it, and those it does not carry and why.

family.description:
The family, spelled as `--remote` and a service binding spell it: a
node family as a configuration's `component:` value, or `embedder`,
which no node is and a `dense` node names with `embedder:`.

local.description:
The names this build gives a `Local` component in it: `impl:` values,
or for `embedder`, `embedder:` values.

not_carried.description:
The names the binary gives a `Local` component of the family in some
build and not in this one, each with what a build needs to carry it.

ports.description:
The ports a node of the family declares, as the pipeline grammar
derives them from the family alone; `null` for `embedder`, which no
node is.

FamilyPorts.description:
The ports of a node family: the kind it puts on its output edge, and
the kinds its input edges carry, by position.

consumes.description: The kinds of value it consumes.

produces.description: The kind of value a node of the family produces.

FeedingRun.description:
A run that counts for the matrix's pipeline: one that fills a cell, or
one launched as it whose content has since changed.

benchmark_names.description: Every benchmark the registry pins to that digest, sorted.

content_since_changed.description:
For a run launched as this pipeline whose content has since changed
(ADR-C39 § 7): how it was launched, and its parameter difference
against the pipeline's current document; `null` for a run that fills
a cell.

dataset_version.description: The digest of the dataset it ran on.

fills_column.description: Whether it is the run its column shows.

launched_as.description:
The run's launch record, as it was written once with the run; `null`
when it has none. ADR-C39 § 4's first fact: what the run was launched
as, never resolved with `pipeline_names` into one name.

pipeline_names.description:
Every workspace document whose canonical hash is the run's, sorted —
ADR-C39 § 4's content fact.

prefix_of.description:
For a prefix of the matrix's pipeline's current form — by its launch
record's parent hash, or by the structural test — the pipeline and the
node it stops at; `null` otherwise.

started_at_ms.description: When it started, from its own record; `null` when unknown.

FoundVersions.description: The digests of the dataset on disk.

dataset_version.description: What the dataset on disk digests to.

index_version.description:
What its derived chunk set digests to; `null` when it was not
compared — the dataset already differs, or the check is the ground
truth's, which depends on the dataset alone.

Graph.description:
A pipeline as a graph: its declared inputs, its nodes and the edges
between them.

edges.description:
One edge per entry of a node's `inputs`, grouped by consuming node in
node order, then in port order.

inputs.description: The values the pipeline receives from its caller, in declared order.

nodes.description: The nodes, sorted by id — the canonical order.

GraphEdge.description: A data edge: `from`'s output feeds `to`'s input at `port`.

from.description: The producing node, or a declared input.

kind.description: The kind of value the producer puts on it.

port.description: The position of this edge among `to`'s inputs, from 0.

id.description: The id nodes name it by.

kind.description: What it carries: the query, for every pipeline this build reads.

family.description:
Its component family, spelled as a configuration's `component:`
value: `retriever`, `fusion`, `reranker`, `context_builder`,
`generator` or `extension`.

implementation.description: Its `impl:` name; an extension node's kind.

GroundTruth.description:
The ground truth a benchmark carries: which metric families a run over it
can compute.

oneOf.description: Neither qrels nor reference answers.
Qrels: the retrieval metrics.
Reference answers: the generation metrics against reference.
Both.

ImportRequest.description: `POST /benchmarks/import`: a corpus on disk, and the name to import it as.

name.description: The local benchmark's name: one directory name.

path.description:
The directory holding the corpus and its ground truth, on the
server's disk.

JobEvent.description:
One event of `GET /jobs/events`: its name, the SSE `event` field, and
its data, the SSE `data` field. The stream sends the two as SSE fields,
not as this object; the schema is the map from a name to its data's type.

oneOf.description: A job accepted into the queue.
A job taken by its worker, or a progress tick.
A job finished.
A job failed.
A job cancelled.
A queued job moved by a reorder.

The whole queue, sent when the stream cannot replay what a client
missed.

JobFault.description: A job file the queue could not read, or a write of it that failed.

reason.description: What went wrong, and what the queue did about it.

JobListing.description:
`GET /jobs`: every job, in its place, and every fault of the queue's
record.

faults.description:
A job file that does not read, or a write of the queue's record that
failed — reported, never repaired.

jobs.description:
The jobs, by position: the order accepted and as reordered; each
lane's queued jobs in the order its worker takes them.

JobStatus.description:
Where a job stands. A time is in milliseconds since the epoch, `null`
when the clock read before it.

oneOf.description: Waiting for its lane's worker.
Executing: a run counts queries, a download bytes.

median_latency_nanos.description:
A run's median query latency so far: the lower median of each
executed query's latency, the sum of its trace's durations — the
figure `GET /runs` lists once it is filed. `null` before the
first query, and for a download.

total.description:
Queries in the benchmark, or bytes in the snapshot; `null` until
the first tick.

oneOf.description: Finished.

id_mismatch.description:
Both ids, when the run is filed under another than the one it
announced.

run_id.description:
The id the run is filed under — computed from what ran; `null`
for a download.

oneOf.description:
Failed; `interrupted` for a job found running when the service
started.

at_node.description: The node that failed, when one did.

oneOf.description: Cancelled before it finished.

JobSummary.description: One job: what it does and where it stands.

created_at_ms.description:
When it was accepted, in milliseconds since the epoch; `null` when
the clock read before it.

position.description: Its place: a lane's worker takes the queued job with the lowest.

oneOf.description: A run, on the run lane.

bindings.description: The `Remote` bindings in force at submission.

pipeline.description: The pipeline's name in the workspace.

run_id.description: The run id announced at submission.

up_to.description: The node a prefix run stops after; `null` for a whole run.

oneOf.description: A benchmark download, on the download lane.

held.description:
Whether the workspace holds [`name`](Self::name) now; `null` when the
record names none, and only then. `GET /runs` and the pipeline matrix
read it from the same listing of `pipelines/` as their hash matches;
`GET /runs/{id}` lists no `pipelines/`, so it stays one run's read
that a broken document cannot fail, and sends `unchecked`. A fact
about the name, not the content: a document held under it may hold
other content since.

name.description:
The workspace pipeline name it was launched as — for a prefix run,
its parent's; `null` when the record names none.

prefix_of.description: For a prefix run, where it was cut from its parent; `null` otherwise.

LaunchedPrefix.description: Where a launch record says a prefix run was cut from its parent.

parent_pipeline_hash.description: The canonical hash of the parent's version it was cut from.

Layout.description:
Where the editor draws each node: UI metadata beside the document, never
in its hash. Also the body of `PUT /pipelines/{name}/layout`.

nodes.description: Each node's position, by node id.

version.description: The layout format's version: `1`, the only one this build reads.

Location.description: Where in a pipeline a validation failure is.

edge.description: The edge concerned, when there is one.

node.description: The node concerned, when there is one.

MatrixCell.description: One node on one benchmark: its figure, or why it has none.

oneOf.description:
Measured: a ranking node's metrics at its output, as
`GET /runs/{id}/queries` reports them, or the generator's
answer metrics, as the run recorded them.

gain.description:
The gain over the previous ranking stage, which is what says
where a node helps, or why there is none.

judged_queries.description:
How many judged queries a ranking node's means are over; `null`
for the generator, whose figures are the run's.

oneOf.description:
A ranking node, on a benchmark that carries no qrels: never
measurable there.

The generator, on a benchmark that carries no reference answers:
never measurable there.
No counted run on this benchmark: measurable, not measured.

The column's run is a prefix that stops before this node: "not run:
the prefix run stops at `up_to`".

up_to.description: The node the prefix run stops at.

oneOf.description:
A node whose output no metric reads — a context builder, an
extension's value, a generator that is not the output.

A ranking node, read against a dataset that is not the run's own on
disk: the column's `dataset_check` says why.

Measurable and run, and no figure: the node ranked no judged query —
it failed — or the run recorded no answer metric.

Not run on this version: the only runs on this benchmark were launched
as this pipeline before its content changed (ADR-C39 § 6). They fill
no cell; the most recent of them is linked.

run.description: That run's id, listed among the feeding runs.

MatrixColumn.description: One benchmark of the matrix, and the run that fills it.

benchmark_names.description:
Every benchmark the registry pins to that digest, sorted; empty when
it pins none.

cells.description: One cell per row, in the rows' order.

dataset_check.description:
Whether the dataset on disk is the run's own, which the ranking
figures are read against; `null` when no run fills the column.

dataset_version.description: The digest of the benchmark's dataset, as runs over it record it.

ground_truth.description:
The ground truth it carries: read off the dataset when it verified,
otherwise off the metrics the run recorded; `null` for a benchmark no
run measured.

run.description:
The run that fills the column — the most recent run of the whole
current form on this benchmark, or, with none, the most recent prefix
of it; `null` when neither ran on it.

up_to.description: For a prefix run, the node it stops at; `null` otherwise.

MatrixGain.description: A matrix cell's gain over the previous ranking stage, or why it has none.

oneOf.description:
Per metric, the node's value minus the best value of the nearest
stage before its own.

The node is at the first ranking stage — a retrieval leg: nothing
comes before it, and the value stands alone.

The pipeline's stages are a guess — two fusions, two rerankers, or a
reranker upstream of the fusion — so which stage came before this one
is too, and no gain is served as fact. Compare's stages say
`confidence: low` over the same derivation.
The node is at no ranking stage: the generator.

MatrixRow.description: One node of the matrix's pipeline.

family.description: Its component family, as a configuration's `component:` spells it.

produces.description:
The kind of value it produces: `chunks` for a ranking node, `answer`
for a generator.

MetricDeltas.description: One metric's per-query deltas, and their histogram.

bins.description:
The seven bins, from the worst to the best: they partition the
queries with a delta.

deltas.description:
Each such query's score in the run minus its score in the baseline,
by query id.

judged_queries.description:
How many queries have a delta: those judged, and scored at both
runs' outputs.

oneOf.description: A higher value is better.
A lower value is better.

MetricFamily.description: Which ground truth a metric reads, as the listing names it.

oneOf.description: Scored from qrels.
Scored from reference answers.

A name the catalogue does not know: shown with its stored name and
value, ranked against nothing.

MetricRow.description: One metric across the runs compared.

best.description:
The runs holding the best value, by `direction`: every one on a tie;
none when `direction` is `null`.

deltas.description:
Each run's value minus the baseline's; `null` where either did not
record it. The baseline's own is `0`.

direction.description:
Which way it improves, from `ragondin-metrics`' catalogue; `null`
for a name the catalogue does not know, which then has no best.

values.description: Each run's value; `null` where the run did not record it.

MissingCells.description:
The nodes of one column no run measured, which a run of the whole
pipeline on its benchmark would.

benchmark.description:
The benchmark to launch on: the first name pinned to the digest;
`null` when the registry pins none, and nothing can be launched.

nodes.description: The nodes, in the rows' order.

NameHeld.description: Whether the workspace holds a recorded pipeline name now.

oneOf.description:
A document is stored under the name exactly as recorded, whether or
not it validates, and none under a case alias of it.

A document is stored under the same name in another ASCII case, a
case alias the backend refuses to read the name as (`request_invalid`)
— whether or not the name is also stored as recorded, as it can be on
a filesystem that keeps case.
No document is stored under the name in any case.
This endpoint does not check: `GET /runs/{id}` lists no `pipelines/`.

NodeLatency.description: One node's latency over a run's queries.

family.description: Its component family, as a configuration's `component:` spells it.

median_nanos.description:
The median of its durations, in nanoseconds: the lower of the two
middle values over an even count, so it is a duration that occurred.

queries.description: How many queries it ran for.

NodeMetrics.description: One node's ranking metrics over the run.

judged_queries.description:
How many queries the means are over: the judged queries for which the
node produced a ranking. A query without qrels is never in it, as it
is never in the harness's means; `0` when the ground truth is not
verified.

metrics.description:
The ranking metrics of its ranking, averaged over `judged_queries`;
`null` when that is none, or when the ground truth is not verified.

produces_ranking.description:
Whether the node produced a ranking for at least one query. A context
builder, a generator and a node that failed on every query did not.

NodePair.description:
Two nodes compared with each other: the second is shown at the first's
stage.

label.description:
What the pair compares, replacing the stage's name in the row; absent
for none.

NotCarried.description: A `Local` implementation this build does not carry.

name.description: Its name: an `impl:` value, or for `embedder`, an `embedder:` value.

reason.description:
Why this build does not carry it, in words: the feature a build needs
to carry it.

Pairing.description:
A manual pairing between two pipelines: a list of node pairs, kept under
`pipelines/<pipeline>.pairing/<other>.json` and read in both directions.
Also the body's `pairing` in `POST /compare`, which keeps it.

other.description: The pipeline the pairs' `other` belongs to.

pairs.description:
The pairs. Empty in a request: "Reset to automatic", which removes
the pairing.

pipeline.description: The pipeline the pairs' `node` belongs to.

PairingSource.description: Where a stage's pairing comes from.

oneOf.description: Derived from the nodes' kinds and positions.
Drawn by hand, and remembered for the pair of pipelines.

ParameterName.description: A node's parameter, as a configuration spells it.

oneOf.description: The node's `component:` family.
The node's `impl:` name.
A key under the node's `params:`.

ParameterRow.description: One parameter that is not the same in every run.

values.description: Each run's value; `null` where its configuration does not set it.

document.description: The document, byte for byte as the file holds it.

error.description: Why it does not validate, when it does not.

etag.description: The digest of those bytes; also the response's `ETag` header, quoted.

hash.description: The content hash of its canonical logical form, when it validates.

PipelineDocument.description:
`PUT /pipelines/{name}` and `POST /pipelines/validate`: a pipeline
document, as text.

document.description:
The YAML document. Stored byte for byte when it is written: never
re-serialized.

PipelineError.description:
Why a pipeline document does not validate: `pipeline_invalid`'s detail and
location, inside a response that still answers.

detail.description: What the validation pass said, in the words `ragondin validate` uses.

location.description: The node and the edge it concerns, when they can be named.

PipelineLayout.description:
`GET /pipelines/{name}/layout`: the layout beside the document, if it has
one. Without one the UI lays the graph out itself, and says so.

layout.description: The layout, or `null` when the pipeline has none.

PipelineListing.description: `GET /pipelines`: every pipeline document in the workspace.

pipelines.description: One entry per document, by name.

PipelineMatrix.description:
`GET /pipelines/{name}/matrix`: one workspace pipeline's node × benchmark
matrix, over the runs of its current canonical form and of its prefixes
(ADR-C39 § 6). Derived from the stored runs on every request: it is no
object of its own.

cache_errors.description:
Why derived figures could not be cached under the workspace's
`cache/`, one entry per failure; empty otherwise. The response is
complete either way.

columns.description:
One column per benchmark a feeding run ran on — and, with
`include_available`, per benchmark the registry knows that none did —
ordered by benchmark name.

feeding_runs.description:
Every run that counts for this pipeline — of its current canonical
form, a prefix of it, or launched as it with content that has since
changed — the most recent first, each saying whether it fills its
column.

missing.description:
Per column, the nodes no run measured that a run of the whole
pipeline on that benchmark would: what a launch would fill. Never on a
benchmark where such a run exists.

pipeline.description: The pipeline's name: its document under `pipelines/`.

pipeline_hash.description:
The canonical hash of the document as it is now: the runs whose
pipeline hash is this one fill cells, under whatever name they ran.

rows.description:
The pipeline's nodes in topological order, ties by id, so the matrix
reads like the pipeline. A judge row is reserved, and absent until the
judge exists.

unreadable.description:
The runs the store lists and cannot load, with its reason: neither
counted nor silently dropped, as `GET /runs` lists them.

PipelineSummary.description: A pipeline, as the listing shows it.

error.description: Why it does not validate, when it does not.

etag.description: The digest of its bytes, the value `If-Match` names to write it.

hash.description: The content hash of its canonical logical form, when it validates.

modified_ms.description:
When its file was last modified, in milliseconds since the Unix
epoch; `null` for a time before the epoch, which is unknown, never
`0`.

PipelineValidated.description: `POST /pipelines/validate`: the document validates, and this is its hash.

hash.description:
The content hash of the canonical logical form, as `ragondin validate`
prints it.

etag.description: The etag of the bytes now stored; also the `ETag` header, quoted.

hash.description: The content hash of their canonical logical form.

Position.description: A node's position on the editor's canvas.

PrefixOf.description: A prefix run's place in its parent pipeline.

up_to.description: The node the prefix stops at: its output.

ProbeRequest.description:
`POST /services/{family}/{name}/probe`: what the identity read needs
besides the binding.

served_model.description:
The name the service serves the model under — a node's
`served_model`. An embedder, a reranker or a generator reports an
identity only for one; a context builder takes none. Absent is none.

ProbeResult.description: `POST /services/{family}/{name}/probe`: the identity a run would record.

identity.description:
What the service reported, read as the composition root reads it
before a run.

Problem.description:
An error, as `application/problem+json` (RFC 9457) with this API's own
members: a stable `code`, a `hint` naming the action, and a `location` for
a validation failure.

code.description:
The stable code a client matches on: one of `ApiError::CODES`, which
the schema lists as an enum so a generated client can narrow on it.

detail.description: What happened, in this occurrence's words.

etag.description:
The stored document's etag, for `precondition_failed` when one is
stored — the value the `ETag` header carries quoted, for a client
that reads the body alone. Present only then.

hint.description: The action that would resolve it.

link.description:
For `run_exists`, where what already holds the run id is read:
`/api/v1/jobs/<id>` for a job queued or running under it,
`/api/v1/runs/<id>` for a stored run. Present only then.

location.description:
Where in a pipeline a validation failure is. Present only for
`pipeline_invalid`.

name.description:
The parameter, path parameter or header a `parameter_invalid` is
about, when it is known. Absent otherwise — never guessed.

title.description: A short, fixed summary of the code.

delta.description: Its score in the run minus its score in the baseline.

QueryScores.description: One query, as the run executed it.

duration_nanos.description:
Its latency, in nanoseconds: the sum of its nodes' durations — each
component's own time, as the trace records it. `null` when that sum
overflows, which only a malformed trace can make it do.

scores.description:
Its scores at the run's output, by metric name: the ranking metrics
when its qrels are non-empty, the answer metrics when it has a
reference. Empty when it is judged on neither, or when the ground
truth is not verified.

text.description:
Its text, the dataset's: present when the ground truth is
`verified` and the dataset holds the query; `null` otherwise.

QueryTrace.description:
`GET /runs/{id}/trace/{query}`: one query's trace, node by node, in the
order the nodes ran, with each named chunk's passage text when the run's
own dataset is on disk.

passages.description:
Whether passage text could be resolved: only against the dataset the
run was evaluated on, digests compared (ADR-C36 § 4).

scores.description:
The query's scores at the run's output, as `GET /runs/{id}/queries`
reports them: present when the dataset on disk is the run's, whatever
the chunk set.

text.description:
The query's text, the dataset's: present when the dataset on disk is
the run's, whatever the chunk set — the gate `scores` is under — and
it holds the query; `null` otherwise, and `passages` says why.

ReorderRequest.description: `PATCH /jobs/{id}`: where to move a queued job.

position.description:
Its place among its lane's queued jobs, from 0 — the next taken. A
place past the last moves it last.

RunAccepted.description: `POST /runs`: the job accepted, and the run id it announced.

run_id.description:
The run id the launcher announced: the one the run is filed under,
unless what ran differs from what was announced, which the job's
terminal state then reports.

RunDeltas.description: One run's per-query deltas against the baseline.

metrics.description:
One entry per ranking metric both it and the baseline recorded, in
name order.

bindings.description: The `Remote` bindings it used, outside its identity.

configuration.description: The configuration document that produced it, verbatim.

finished_at_ms.description:
When its evaluation finished, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch,
outside its identity; `null` when unknown.

graph.description:
The graph lowered from [`configuration`](Self::configuration) by the
pipeline grammar's one implementation — never by the browser.

launched_as.description:
The run's launch record, as [`RunSummary::launched_as`] serves it;
`null` for a run stored without one. A prefix run says what it was
cut from here, in the record's `prefix_of`: the parent's name, the
node it stops at and the parent's canonical hash.

metrics.description: What it scored, by metric name.

started_at_ms.description:
When it started, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, outside its
identity; `null` when unknown.

RunIdMismatch.description: A run filed under another id than it announced: both.

decided.description: The id computed from what ran, which the run is filed under.

RunInputs.description: The components of a run's identity tuple.

pipeline.description: The content hash of the canonical logical pipeline.

RunLatency.description: One run's latency, node by node.

nodes.description: Every node that ran, by id.

RunListing.description:
`GET /runs`: every run the store holds, and every one it holds but cannot
read.

cache_error.description:
Why a run's median query latency could not be read from or written
to the workspace's `cache/`, the first such reason; absent when the
cache served or took every run, so a listing whose cache works reads
as it always has. The listing is complete either way: the cache is
never a truth, so its failure fails nothing.

runs.description: The readable runs, in the store's listing order.

shapes.description:
The shape of every pipeline a readable run ran, once per pipeline,
keyed by its canonical hash ([`RunSummary::pipeline`]): the graph
`GET /runs/{id}` serves for a run of it, by the same conversion. A
pipeline whose every run's stored document no longer lowers has no
entry, as `GET /runs/{id}` has no graph for it.

unreadable.description:
The runs the store lists and cannot load — reported, never dropped
and never repaired.

RunQueries.description:
`GET /runs/{id}/queries`: every query the run executed, its scores read
from the trace against the run's own ground truth, and the per-node
ranking metrics.

Derived data: computed on read and cached under the workspace's `cache/`,
never stored in the run, and identical whether the cache was there or not.

answer_node.description:
The node whose answer the answer metrics read, when the pipeline ends
in one.

cache_error.description:
Why the figures could not be cached under the workspace's `cache/`,
when they could not; `null` otherwise. The response is complete
either way: the cache is never a truth, so its failure fails nothing.

ground_truth.description:
Whether the ground truth the scores are read against is the run's
own: the dataset on disk digests to the run's `dataset_version`. The
chunk set is not compared — a score depends on the qrels and the
reference answers, not on passage text. Scores and per-node metrics
are present only when it is `verified`.

metrics.description:
The metrics a query can be scored on: those the run recorded that are
read per query, by name.

nodes.description:
Every node of the pipeline, in the canonical order, with its ranking
metrics averaged over the run's judged queries.

queries.description:
The queries, in the run's order (by id) — all of them, or those the
`missing_gold_at` filter kept.

ranking_node.description:
The node whose ranking the ranking metrics read (ADR-C30 § 3), when the
pipeline has one.

RunRequest.description:
`POST /runs`: what to run. The bindings are not sent: the workspace's
bindings in force — those `GET /services` lists — are snapshotted into
the job at submission.

pipeline.description:
The workspace pipeline's name; its document is snapshotted into the
job at submission, so an edit afterwards changes nothing queued.

up_to.description: The node a prefix run stops after; absent for the whole pipeline.

RunSummary.description: One run, as the listing shows it.

benchmark_names.description:
Every registry entry pinned to [`dataset_version`](Self::dataset_version)
— a manifest entry or an import — sorted; empty when none is. The
pinning `GET /runs/{id}/queries` locates the run's dataset by, never
resolved by closeness (ADR-C36 § 4); naming a benchmark here loads and
verifies nothing.

finished_at_ms.description:
When the run's evaluation finished, in milliseconds since the Unix
epoch, as the process that ran it recorded; `null` when unknown.

id.description: The run's content address: 64 lowercase hex digits.

launched_as.description:
The run's launch record, as it was written once with the run, read
and never computed or inferred; `null` for a run stored without one.
Recorded at launch, so its name may be a pipeline whose content has
since changed, or that no longer exists. ADR-C39 § 4's other fact,
never resolved with [`pipeline_names`](Self::pipeline_names) into one
name.

median_query_latency_nanos.description:
The lower median, over the run's queries, of each query's latency —
the sum of its trace's node durations — in nanoseconds.
Derived, never stored in the run: read from the traces alone, so a
run whose dataset is not on disk has it too, and cached under the
workspace's `cache/`. Not the run's wall time, which
`finished_at_ms − started_at_ms` gives, preparation included. `null`
when no trace of the run reads.

metric_families.description:
The family of each metric, keyed exactly like
[`metrics`](Self::metrics): from `ragondin-metrics`' catalogue, and
`unknown` for a name it does not know — kept, never dropped.

metrics.description: What the run scored, by metric name.

pipeline.description: The content hash of the canonical logical pipeline it ran.

pipeline_names.description:
Every workspace pipeline document whose canonical hash is the run's,
sorted; empty when none is. The current hash match, found by content
when the listing is asked for, so a document edited since the run no
longer names it. Of the two facts ADR-C39 § 4 exposes about a run's
pipeline, this is the content one; it is not a resolution of
[`launched_as`](Self::launched_as), nor that of this.

started_at_ms.description:
When the run started, in milliseconds since the Unix epoch, as the
process that ran it recorded; `null` when unknown.

ServiceAddress.description: `PUT /services/{family}/{name}`: the address to bind the name to.

uri.description:
The service's address — the scheme `http`, a host and an optional
port, nothing else — as `ragondin bench --remote` takes it.

ServiceBinding.description:
A `Remote` component bound by family and name to the address it answers
at — in the workspace's settings, and as a run recorded it.

family.description: The family the name is bound in: `generator`, `embedder`, ….

name.description: The implementation name a node uses.

ServiceListing.description:
`GET /services`, and the answer of every write to a service: the bindings
`workspace.toml` holds.

services.description: Every binding, in the file's order.

ServiceStatus.description: One binding, and what this server last learnt by probing it.

connected.description:
Whether this server's last probe of it, at this address, read an
identity. `false` before any probe.

family.description: The family the name is bound in.

identity.description: The identity last read at this address, if any was.

name.description: The implementation name a node uses.

SettingsSummary.description: The workspace's settings: deployment data, never hashed into a run.

datasets.description: The directory benchmarks are read from.

SinceChangedLaunch.description: How a run of since-changed content was launched.

oneOf.description: As the pipeline: "launched as N; content since changed".

As a prefix of the pipeline, cut from a version that is not the
current one: "a prefix of an earlier version of N". Never an earlier
version of N itself (ADR-C39 § 2).

The run's pipeline has no node at this stage: "no stage here", an
absence, never a zero.
The run's nodes at this stage.

best.description:
Per metric, the best value among the nodes and the node it is
from — for the legs, the best leg. Empty without a verified
ground truth.

nodes.description:
Each node, in the pipeline's canonical order — several only for
the retrieval legs, or where a pair drawn by hand joined one.

StageName.description: A stage of a pipeline, in the order a ranking travels through them.

oneOf.description: The retrievers.
The fusion.
The reranker.
The ranking the run's retrieval metrics were read at.
The generator's answer.

metrics.description:
Its ranking metrics averaged over the judged queries, as
`GET /runs/{id}/queries` reports them; `null` without a verified
ground truth or when it ranked no judged query.

paired_by_hand.description: Whether a pair drawn by hand placed it here.

StageRow.description: One stage across the runs compared.

confidence.description:
`low` when a pipeline's graph was ambiguous at this stage — two
fusions, two rerankers, a reranker upstream of the fusion — and the
automatic pairing is a guess.

label.description:
What the row compares, in the words of the pair drawn by hand into
it; `null` when no pair named it.

source.description: `manual` when a pair drawn by hand placed a node in it.

StageValue.description: A metric's value at a stage, and the node it is read at.

TraceNodeView.description: One node of a query's trace.

duration_nanos.description: How long its component took, in nanoseconds.

error.description: The failure it reported; `null` when it succeeded.

gold_ranks.description:
The 1-based ranks of the gold documents — graded above 0 — in its
ranking, counted over documents folded from its chunks by first
occurrence, the ranking its `metrics` score: present when it produced
a ranking, the query is judged and the dataset on disk is the run's;
empty when it ranked no gold document; `null` otherwise.

inputs.description: What it received, one summary per input port, in port order.

metrics.description:
The ranking metrics of what it produced for this query: present when
it produced a ranking, the query is judged and the dataset on disk is
the run's; `null` otherwise.

output.description: What it produced; `null` when it failed.

TracePassage.description: One named chunk, with its passage text when it could be resolved.

document.description: The document it was derived from.

grade.description:
Its document's grade in the query's qrels, `0` when they do not judge
it: present when the query is judged and the dataset on disk is the
run's, whatever the chunk set; `null` otherwise.

score.description: The score the node gave it, on the node's own scale.

text.description:
Its text: present only when the passages are `verified` and the chunk
set derived from the dataset holds this id; `null` otherwise.

TraceValue.description:
A value along an edge, as the trace records it: sized on an input port,
named where a node produced it.

oneOf.description: A query, by id.
A list of chunks, counted.
The chunks a node produced, in its own order.

chunks.description: The chunks, in the order the node returned them.

oneOf.description: A context, sized.

text_bytes.description: The length of its text, in bytes of UTF-8.

oneOf.description: The context a node produced.

chunks.description: Its chunks, in the order the builder placed them.

text.description: Its rendered text, whole, as the trace records it.

oneOf.description: An answer, sized.

text_bytes.description: The length of its text, in bytes of UTF-8.

oneOf.description: The answer a node produced.

text.description: Its text, as the generator returned it.

UnplacedPair.description:
A pair drawn by hand that a comparison could not apply to one of its
runs: a node it names is not a retriever, fusion or reranker of the run
it would be read in. A pairing is kept against two pipelines' current
documents, and applies to a run launched under a pipeline's name whose
content has since changed for the nodes that run still has (decided in #402); every
other pair is reported here, never skipped and never guessed onto
another node.

pair.description:
The pair, oriented from the baseline's pipeline as
[`Comparison::pairings`] holds it.

run.description:
The compared run, other than the baseline, the pair was not applied
to.

UnreadableRun.description: A run the store lists but cannot load, and why.

id.description: The id the store lists it under.

Workspace.description:
`GET /workspace`: where the server works, how it is set up, which build is
answering and what that build can run.

build.description:
The build's identity. The UI compares it with its own and reloads when
they differ (ADR-C36 § 1); the same value is on every response in the
`x-ragondin-build` header.

capabilities.description: What this build can run, as the launcher reports it.

counts.description: What the workspace holds, counted on this request.

path.description: The workspace's root directory, as the binary resolved it.

settings.description: The deployment settings the workspace holds.

WorkspaceCounts.description: What a workspace holds, counted when asked: nothing here is cached.

benchmarks_ready.description:
The benchmarks on disk whose digest is the one expected of them:
`ready` or `local`.

pipelines.description: The pipeline documents under `pipelines/`, valid or not.

runs.description: The runs the store lists, readable or not.

services_connected.description:
The bound services whose last probe, by this server, at their current
address, read an identity.

post.description: The download runs on its own lane, alongside a run; its progress is bytes. A name the manifest does not hold, a benchmark already on disk or a digest that differs fails the job, in the registry's words.

202.description: Queues a download of a benchmark the manifest names, verified against its digests.

post.summary: Queues a download of a benchmark the manifest names, verified against its digests.

post.description: Two to five runs, each once, the baseline among them. More than five, or runs whose dataset_version differs, is runs_not_comparable (409), naming the ceiling or both versions; there is no comparison across benchmarks. A body's `pairing` — between the baseline's pipeline and another compared run's — is checked first and applied to this comparison, and kept under `pipelines/<pipeline>.pairing/<other>.json` only once the response is built, so a refused request keeps nothing; it is read in both directions after. With no pairs it is removed ("Reset to automatic"). A pairing of other pipelines, or a pair naming a node that is not a retriever, fusion or reranker of its pipeline, is request_invalid. A run's pipeline, for its pairings, is the name its launch record gives, whatever that pipeline's content has become, else the one document holding its hash. A pairing applies to the nodes each run has; every pair a run cannot place is listed in unplaced_pairs with the side lacking its node, never skipped and never moved onto another node.

200.description: Runs of one benchmark against a baseline: the metric table, the parameter matrix, the stages with their pairing, the per-query deltas and their bins, and the latency per node.

post.summary: Runs of one benchmark against a baseline: the metric table, the parameter matrix, the stages with their pairing, the per-query deltas and their bins, and the latency per node.

get.description: Each event is named after the state entered — queued, running, done, failed, cancelled — or reordered, and its data is the job as a JobSummary; a run's running events tick once per query, a download's in bytes. Its id is `<process>:<number>`: reconnecting with Last-Event-ID replays every event missed, once, while this server still holds them. Otherwise the stream begins with resync, whose data is the whole queue as a JobListing. JobEvent maps each name to its data's schema; the stream sends them as the SSE `event` and `data` fields.

parameters.description:
The id of the last event the client received, to resume after it.
Absent, or one this server no longer holds the events after, and the
stream begins with `resync`.
parameters.name: Last-Event-ID

get.summary: Every job transition and progress tick, as server-sent events.

delete.description: The running job stays running until the launcher honours the cancellation; the cancelled event says when, and the traces of the queries it executed are kept under jobs/<id>/partial/, never in the store. A job that already ended is job_finished (409).

200.description: Cancels a job: a queued one at once, never executed; the running one between two queries.

delete.summary: Cancels a job: a queued one at once, never executed; the running one between two queries.

get.summary: One job: what it does and where it stands.

get.summary: Every pipeline document: its etag, its hash or why it does not validate.

200.description: The canonical hash `ragondin validate` prints for a document, or `pipeline_invalid`, located.

post.summary: The canonical hash `ragondin validate` prints for a document, or `pipeline_invalid`, located.

get.description: The etag is also the response's `ETag` header, quoted.

put.description: A write states one precondition: `If-Match` to replace the stored document, or `If-None-Match: *` to create one. A stale etag, `If-Match: *` with nothing stored, a creation over an existing document, or neither header is precondition_failed (412), with the current etag in the `ETag` header, the detail and the problem's `etag` member, and nothing written; both headers at once is request_invalid. A document the composition root refuses — a key no component reads — is pipeline_invalid, in `ragondin bench`'s words. The answer's etag is also its `ETag` header.

parameters.description:
`"<etag>"` to replace the stored document with that etag — a weak
`W/` tag reads as its strong form — or `*` to replace whatever is
stored.
parameters.name: If-Match

parameters.description: `*`, to create the document: nothing may be stored under the name.
parameters.name: If-None-Match

put.summary: Stores a document byte for byte when it validates and its precondition holds.

200.description: The layout beside a pipeline document, or `null`.

get.summary: The layout beside a pipeline document, or `null`.

200.description: Replaces the layout beside a pipeline document; never changes its etag or hash.

put.summary: Replaces the layout beside a pipeline document; never changes its etag or hash.

get.description: A run fills a cell when its pipeline hash is the document's current one, under any name, or when it is a prefix of the current document — its launch record's parent_pipeline_hash is the current hash, or else the structural test says so, for every run. A run whose launch record names the pipeline and that is neither fills no cell: it is a feeding run with content_since_changed, its parameter difference against the current document, and a benchmark whose only runs are such runs reads not_run_on_this_version, linking one. Any other run counts nowhere. Each column is the most recent run of the whole current form on its benchmark, or, with none, the most recent prefix — the greatest started_at_ms, a run with no time after every run with one, ties by run id — so `missing` never names a launch that exists. A ranking cell's gain is over_previous_stage, first_stage (a leg), ambiguous (the stage derivation guessed) or unstaged. A feeding run carries its launch record (launched_as) and the documents sharing its hash (pipeline_names) side by side. An empty cell says why: no_qrels, no_reference_answers, not_run_yet (with the benchmark), prefix_stops (with the node the prefix stops at), not_run_on_this_version (with the run), not_scored, unverified, no_figure. `include_available=true` adds a column for every benchmark the registry knows that no counted run ran on.

parameters.description:
Also give a column to every benchmark the registry knows that no
counted run ran on, each of its cells not_run_yet. Absent is false.
parameters.name: include_available

post.description: The pipeline's document is read from the workspace and validated (pipeline_invalid), the bindings in force are read from the settings, and the launcher computes the run id from constructed components and the services' identities — impl_not_in_build, service_unreachable or pipeline_invalid when it cannot. An id a job not yet ended holds, or the store holds, is run_exists (409), whose `link` is the job's or the run's path. The run is filed under the id computed from what ran; when it differs from the announced one, the job's done state reports both.
